Adventure.name: Tower inv
Adventure.nodes:
Theodore appears and looks shaken up:
'Ah, hello again. Have you felt it? An odd tingling, a disturbance, no?'

'Ah, yes, so it stirs even the divine senses. Well, nothing else to do but send the chosen to investigate.'
He rushes off after handing you a map and it shows the lands of Ice, so you will need to go there if you wish to learn more.

Adventure.name: Mirror tower
Adventure.nodes:
You enter into a tower, it is empty and quiet but you feel its very walls filled with an odd energy.
The tower is virtually empty, apart from a large, ornate mirror, suspended in the air right in the centre of the building.
The face of the mirror is pitch black and yet, you sense a presence within.

There is an ancient, immense emanation of pure Magic within the mirror.
It is clearly not fully active though, most likely it awaits some kind of a trigger.
You also sense this mirror connects many worlds outside the realm of Thea. But, apart from its otherworldliness, it does not seem malicious.

The face of the mirror shimmers, sensing your connection to the divine. It shows you several places spread across the area. Perhaps places worth seeing?
It also shows you a foreign looking village in the ice lands.

The surface of the mirror turns pitch black as you approach. You get the feeling it is watching you; your divine senses tingle and you know this tower seeks out those who possess magic. It is likely, that were it not for your connection with the gods, the place would have not become visible to you at all.
The mirror and the tower remain unchanged, the trigger is clearly yet to be activated.

You come again to the mirror tower, but before you reach it, you see in the distance two groups pitted against one another.
One has Freya, the mage you rescued, and her foreign servants. They stand before a second group, led by a baba yaga demon, but one who looks far more powerful than any you have seen before.

You get to the mirror tower again, carrying the key from Gargamus.
But before you can enter, you are met by a baba yaga. Although you recognise this type of demon, you also see clearly, she is different. More regal and powerful than any yaga you've ever encountered.

'Ah, a sister, it is good to see you thrive, even if you walk an odd path for an ancient demon. I will keep things simple. I was awakened from my slumber by this foreign intrusion. Although I sense you dealt with at least a part of it.
The mirror, it calls out to those who are strong with magic. No doubt Veles would have heard the call were he not entangled as he is. And Marovit must have his eye on this. Is this why you are here, you are the chosen ilk, no?'

It looks for a second as if the Yaga was about to smirk, but instead, she smiles and bows to you:
'Good, old Veles would be proud of his youngsters, I am sure. This is precisely why I have come. I will heed this call in the name of our lands and I will deal with whatever awaits.
But you, you can aid me. A horde of the fallen wizard, Freya, comes. They are weak now, without her, but they will seek to destroy this tower before I can enter. Defeat them for me and you shall be rewarded.'
'Stand aside, children, I have no time for this! Aid me, leave, or die, your choice?'

You leave and watch from afar. You do see an army approach and the Yaga battle them. The fight goes inside the tower, so you never find out which side won. But the foreign structure eventually disappears.

You walk up to the place where the mirror tower stood, but you only find an empty crater.
The place reeks of burnt-out magic, so something epic must have taken place here.

You defeated the Yaga, and her remaining servants bow before you.
The foreign armies she spoke of tried to destroy the tower while you were busy, but a blast of pure magic force destroyed them. You hear a voice from the mirror:
'You may be the master one day. You have been marked, you will be called, for there can only be one, true master of magic.'
The tower then disappears, but you do sense a mark upon you, although you are unsure if it is your divine self that was marked so, or the chosen servant...
The Yaga is immensely powerful, you can only attack her with your spirit.

You are defeated, but the Yaga leaves you be, as she rushes off to the tower, where the foreign armies are already trying to destroy it.
The Yaga kills them, but she looks exhausted. She enters the tower, but you do not see her leave and the place disappears.

You defeat the enemy, and you see the Yaga has entered the tower as sparks of magical energy emanate from the building.
You hear a booming voice 'There can only be one master of magic, and you may be it, one day.'
A dwarven matrioshka, who served the Yaga, bows before the tower as the whole place disappears.

'The Yaga was called and will represent our lands as a wizard - that is what they call those gifted with the dark arts.
You did well to aid her, I thank you and I ask to join your cause?'

'Aye, you are right to ask. We are women gifted with the magical arts, long, long ago, by the demon Yaga herself. We are few and the magic does not agree with our dwarven ways, and so we only wake when Magic itself calls upon us. It did so now.
We aided the Yaga, and most will now go slumberin' again. But some will stay for a time, gathering knowledge before we sleep. So, can I come with you?'

'Aye, we were slumberin' happily for as you know, magic does not agree well with our kin. But Magic was stirred by this tower, and so we woke.
We aided the Yaga, and most will now slumber again. But some will stay for a time, gathering knowledge before we sleep. So, can I come with you?'

The enemy bled you badly, but when they realised the Yaga entered the tower, they knew they failed anyway, and they left. You see sparks of magical energy emanate from the building.
You hear a booming voice 'There can only be one master of magic, and you may be it, one day'

'Hmm. I suppose you are entitled to try, since you have the key. So, in the spirit of this otherworldly tournament. We shall have to battle it out and the best shall pass.
Or, if you change your mind, you can aid me. A horde of the fallen wizard, Freya, comes. They are weak now, without her, but they will seek to destroy this tower before I can enter. Defeat them for me and you shall be rewarded for your service.'
'In this case, we will deal with the nuisance of the army together and then we shall measure the power of our spirit in battle. Does that satisfy you, divine child?'

'Yes, sister. You may assist me, and I will heed this foreign call in the name of our lands and I will deal with whatever awaits.
A horde of the fallen wizard, Freya, comes. They are weak now, without her, but they will seek to destroy this tower before I can enter. Defeat them for me. One of my servants, the matrioshka, will join in this task and you shall be rewarded.'

'Ha, the cheek! I love it. Well, a sisterly duel it is then. Old ways or the new path of those fancy human gods, we shall see. Yes!
Or, if you change your mind, little one, you can aid me still.'

Adventure.name: Viking settelment
Adventure.nodes:
You come to a foreign settlement, it looks sturdy, but primitive. It is likely only meant as a temporary base.
You see many guards, more than you'd expect from such a small place. The guards are of a strange race, similar to your wolfmen, but more dog than wild wolf perhaps?
There are also white bears and occasionally, you see human warriors with bare chests, and a wild look in their eyes, often wearing bear heads and skins on their shoulders.

One of the canine creatures approaches to greet you, while the guards watch you carefully.
'Ah, natives? I am sorry, we speak your language, but we do not know much about your ways.'

'Oh yes, I am Gnat, my people are called gnolls, we come far from the lands of great sun and dry land. We were taken by our master, and joined their cold, northern clans.
Our boats crashed, we stay here for time, then we go.'
'Ah Master, they are a great wizard, yes. But, they are lost to us, their boat got smashed, and we do not know where they are. Will you help us look, natives? We can pay.'
'A tower with mirror, no, I do not know what this is, but maybe Master does?'
"We travelled to many islands, our master seeks knowledge. Here we sailed, but your Stribog saw fit to strand us. Maybe gods fate, no?'
'Our Master knows many things, they teach us too, so we may serve better. In north, Odin watches seas. Here Stribog. Poseidon we also heard of in the south.'
You destroy the village and kill the inhabitants.

'Ah good. Well, we do not know the lands well. But, we know master is drawn to places where magic sleeps.
We check some already, but more out there.
Please, search, if you find them, tell us. You will know master when you see them, there is none like them...'
'Yes, it is none of your business. Well then, please leave us to our task. We will move out of this camp soon and keep looking.'
You were defeated and chased away. Later, you find that the foreigners have moved on.

The creature sniffs you and a berserker guard answers instead:
'Good, our way spread to this land, as it should be. Now remember that you are human, remember those you love, or hate, matters not, so long as you hold on to your human side, else the bear may take you one day...'
The canine creature only nods.

Adventure.name: GnollChildGrowingup
Adventure.nodes: Your gnoll pup is growing up, but unlike other children, the pup needs to undergo a challenge in order for their instincts to kick in.
The gnoll pup was able to grow into a fierce warmonger.
The gnoll pup was able to grow into a talented shaman.
The gnoll pup was able to grow into a great hunter.
The gnoll pup failed and is not ready to grow up yet.

Adventure.name: Berserker's curse
Adventure.nodes:
You come across a small hamlet and as you approach, you see bloody bodies of many werewolves.
You also spot a group of villagers huddled around a building, lamenting and screaming at someone:
'Stop, please stop now. The beasts are dead, you can stop!'

The village elder sees you coming and speaks up:
'You, you are of the chosen ilk, no? I heard of you, oh thank the lady Lada for such fortune!
Please aid us. Ulfrid, he... he saved us from the wolves, but now he rages on. He locked himself in that house, but he didn't know that our children hid in the basement there... he will surely kill them. Please help.'

'He is an outlander; we took him in months ago. He said his ship sank and he wished to settle away from the cold.
He is a good man, docile and kind. But, our volh warned us he felt a mark of Turmoil so strong on him...
Anyway, our Tosia got the werewolves riled up, silly girl, so they came, a full pack, ten of them. We had no chance.'

'And then Ulfrid, he said he would kill them, but begged us to keep away from him after.
He... he changed, some folk swear he's a wolfman himself, but I saw him, he's more like a bear, or a mad man foaming at the mouth, raging. He killed the wolves, yes, then killed two of ours when they did not heed his warning, then he ran into the building and barricaded himself.'
'Ah, well, that's the issue, Gnievoy is also in the basement, he was sick you see, and so he went in with the children.'

You go in through the back and peer into the main hall of the hut. The place is wrecked, the stove is turned over, the fireplace shattered into rubble, tables, and beds now mere splinters. You see a large figure hunched over the latch door to the basement.
The figure is grunting and growling, and trying to scratch away at the obstacle, but there is a faint aura of magic clearly protecting it, for now.

You defeat the man. The village's volh appears and kneels over the fallen warrior:
'Ah, the pity, if only I was not stricken with sickness, perhaps I could have aided him.
Still, as crazy as it may seem, I have learnt the ways of the berserkers from Ulfrid and will pass on this knowledge to you. Should you ever decide to use it, remember this day and stay weary.'

'They seem to hail from cold lands far in the north, where our gods do not rule...
I believe he meant the lands of Perun's brother, Odin.
After the Shattering, I should imagine the god fares well with all the seas. And it is not surprising their people should appear at our shores, as they are known to favour travel.'

'They are warriors of fierce power but doomed by a blood curse.
They seem to call upon the spirit of the bear, or perhaps the spirit takes them by force? They can be an asset, but also a menace.'

'Good, your young ones will now be able to undergo the trials of the berserker when their croppings comes, if their Destiny is strong enough.
Be well, friends.'

You fail to beat the man, bloodied and beaten you barely escape the building. You hear the cries of the children from within. But then everything goes quiet.
An old volh appears:
'It is over now. Ulfrid has calmed and left. The children are fine, mostly...
I thank you stranger, you wore his strength down so that he was able to stop, although I see you paid a high price.'

'Indeed. You are welcomed to stay with us as you try to save your wounded, alas, our own healer is dead so I will help as I can myself.
As crazy as it may seem at this moment, I have learnt the ways of the berserkers from Ulfrid and will pass on this knowledge to you. Should you ever decide to use it, remember this day and stay wary. '

'Good, your young ones will now be able to undergo the trials of the berserker when their croppings comes, if their Destiny is strong enough.
Be well, friends.'

'Power of course. I have seen folk align with demons, get bitten by wolf men on purpose, or practise death magic and more...
I do not judge; I only pass on my knowledge to the ilk of the chosen.'

They seem to call upon the spirit of the bear, or perhaps the spirit takes them by force? They can be an asset, but also a menace.'

I believe he meant the lands of Perun's brother, Odin.
After the Shattering, I should imagine the god fares well with all the seas. And it is not surprising their people should appear at our shores, as they are known to favour travel.'

I thank you stranger, you wore his strength down so that he was able to stop, although I see you paid a high price.'

You can see your words calming the man, his breathing becomes more regular, and it almost seems like he becomes smaller in stature.
Through gritted teeth he speaks:
'I... lost too much... I will try to stop it now.... whatever happens, thank you...'
You see the man drink a foul-smelling potion.

The man convulses, his body twists and turns into a white bear. The animal speaks:
'The bear spirit called to me; it was time. I walk with you now. I serve.'
The latch of the basement opens and an old volh appears:
'Oh, wonderful, Ulfrid is... well, alive.'

The man convulses, his body twists and turns into a white bear. The animal seems unable to speak, but eager to follow you.
The latch of the basement opens and an old volh appears:
'Oh, wonderful, Ulfrid is... well, alive.'

'Yes, thanks to you. So, I suppose Ulfrid will now go with you.
As crazy as it may seem, I have learnt the ways of the berserkers from Ulfrid, and since his intellect may now be somewhat stunted, (the bear growls at him) I will pass on this knowledge to you. Should you ever decide to use it, remember this day and stay wary. '

'My mind is not clear. I serve.'
The volh renews his offer.

You leave them be, but later, you hear that some northern foreigners have been roaming the lands, berserkers they call themselves. They are an odd kind of fighters who favour Destiny, but the trend is catching on, so you may now train your children as such.
'Yes, perhaps. There is a backdoor into the cellar where the volh and the children are hiding, but it is protected by old magic that clearly even the volh cannot break. Can you try?'

You break the barrier quickly enough, so that the volh and many of the children make it out. You hear the cries of the ones who remained, but you know it could have been worse. Then, everything goes quiet.
The volh who also came out, looks at you with great sadness and gratitude:
'It is over now. Ulfrid has calmed and he will leave now. At least the children I carried out are fine.
I thank you stranger, your divine touch unlocked the barrier, if only it worked sooner... We paid a price, but it is done now...'

Adventure.name: Rat's tale
Adventure.nodes: A group of common rats approaches your rat and they ask to speak to them.
The rats are dead, it seems they were carrying some extra goods on them.
The rats escape.

'You big rat friend, you got more brains than us, you must help.
Many, many rats die, that no strange, but they die weird. They walk into fire and water and magic, stupid rats, more stupid than we. The humans say rat king is here, that rats must die. But who is Rat King? You go check?'

'Good, good. go to our rat lair, we flee from there, you go see.'
They scamper off, but you know where to go next.

Adventure.name: Rat's tale 2
Adventure.nodes: The rat lair is sealed up and only a fellow rat may find their way in and out.

The lair is mostly abandoned, and you found many carcasses of your deceased smaller kin. What is peculiar, is that many of the fallen have their tails tied together in knots.
You notice some movement, and spot a fat rat carrying a load of loot, he sees you too and stops. There's a moment of awkward silence.

'Whoa, whoa, wait there, fella. I'm a lover not a fighter. Here, have some cheese or something... I am Herbert by the way, who are you then?'
As Herbert comes closer, you see his fur is white and he has a huge, heavy scar across his right side, starting from his neck, down to his shoulder. He is also wearing some smart looking clothes.
You attack, but it seems Herbert is some sort of a witch and he fights back with dark magic!

You go round in circles for a time and feel the effects of some nasty magic weakening you. The lair is mostly abandoned, and you find many carcasses of your deceased smaller kin.
What is peculiar, is that many of the fallen have their tails tied together in knots.
You spot a fat rat carrying a load of loot, he sees you too and stops. There's a moment of awkward silence.

'Well, this is somewhat awkward, right? I am Herbert, and I am... well, let's face it, looting this place... And who might you be?'
As Herbert comes closer, you see his fur is white and he has a huge, heavy scar across his right side, starting from his neck, down to his shoulder. He is also wearing some clothes.
'Ah, yes, I see. Makes sense. Well, yes, there seems to be some rat trouble in the area. Many deaths. But mostly the small vermin types, not like me... or you, I suppose...'

'Oddly? Oh, eloquently, you mean? Hmm. A fair question, I suppose. I wear clothes because I am not a savage, and this, my friend, answers both your queries. For indeed I am a cultured foreigner.
I can also write, I'll have you know, and I have learnt the dark arts of magic. Yes, I am an accomplished rat, if you will.'

'I've heard rumours of the Rat King's return. Humanoid folk are up in arms about this. Pitchforks and rat poison, you know the drill.
Who knows, the King is a legend amongst our kind, so maybe he is back?'

You killed Herbert and can take the loot he was carrying out of here.
Unfortunately, you do not find any more clues as to the supposed rat troubles.

'Well, I say, you do have spunk, and potential. So, I shall not be offended by your brutish ways. What can vermin like you do...
How about you tell me why you are here, eh?'

'Hmm, you were not born a noble vermin, dark magic changed your form.
If I decide to pass on my knowledge, you will no longer be cursed, thus returning to your previous, inferior form, may be lost.
Still, I can see why you would desire it. Become a true rat. Yes. I suppose I may be convinced to help.'

'Well, well , well. A chosen of the divine. Now this I must respect...
Very well, I shall teach you, but it will not be free of charge, divine or not.
My first request is a wagon of Ratatouille!'
'There will be a price to pay for my wisdom. My first request is a wagon of Ratatouille!'

'Not so much, no. But good luck with it. Maybe you can meet the Rat King? I hear many villagers are scared of him.
I shall be on my merry way now.'
He turns away to leave.
The lair has little more to show you. But Herbert mentioned villagers being scared of this Rat King, maybe you should ask around.

'I suppose you are too young, or perhaps too primitive to know? He is our saviour, one could say. An alpha rat who is fabled to unite our kind and devour the humanoids who plague us.
That's all for now, little rat. Good luck.'
Herbert suddenly becomes really fast and disappears into a tunnel.

'Ah, shame. Some Franco rats made it for me once... I suppose a cart of gulasz will have to do. The good kind! Or, well, to be honest, any good, cooked food made of meat, yeah. I will find you when you have it for me.'
'Good, off I go then.'

'I've heard rumours of the Rat King's return. Humanoid folk are up in arms about this. Pitchforks and rat poison, you know the drill.
Who knows, the King is a legend amongst our kind, so maybe he is back?
Perhaps once you've learnt more, things will become clearer. Until later.'
'There will be a price to pay for my wisdom. My first request is a wagon of Ratatouille!'
'Ah, yes, I see. Makes sense. Well, yes, there seems to be some rat trouble in the area. Many deaths. But mostly the small vermin types, not like me... or you, I suppose...'

'I was nice before, but it seems savagery cannot be defeated by kindness. Die my inferior vermin friend, die well.'
A final bolt of dark energy rips you apart!
The lair has little more to show you, so best get on with the gulasz.
It seems the rat under your divine guidance has already experienced this quest, they cannot do it again.

'Hmm, yes. Unnerving how you have learnt it without me... As for your question: can't help, no. But good luck with it. Maybe you can meet the Rat King? I hear many villagers are scared of him.
I shall be on my merry way now.'

You were about to turn towards the left, when the unliving rat rises and attacks!

You now have two paths before you.

Adventure.name: Rat's Tale Londek
Adventure.nodes:
You enter the settlement of Londek Zdroy, but it seems empty and quiet.
The deeper you go in, the more you smell the stench of death and... rat droppings.
Finally, you come to a lake upon which this settlement was built, and you see piles of dead, floating bodies.

This place reeks of rats and for some reason, you cannot enter unless you are accompanied by one.
(Or your rats have already been here!)

There seems to be none here left alive, but you hear faint flute music playing nearby.
All non-beasts become entranced so if you continue, you may not have their aid.

You walk into one of the houses and see the floor carpeted with rats. Upon a makeshift throne, sits Herbert and beneath him, chained like an animal, a man playing a sad melody.
Herbert looks at you:
'Ah welcome!'

'Well, my awakened friend, I was going to wait and maybe let you in on the fun, but well...
I do have another three places to visit before I move on. It is simple, I am a rat supreme, a Tsarat. Humans and their likes, I detest!
And so, I play with them as they do with us. Extermination. On a small scale, of course, I am not a mad rat...'

'Oh come, my friend. Have you never been annoyed about how they treat us?
This here Harris fella, he chopped off my second head! With an axe!
So, I made him into the Pipe Piper, the saviour of man, king against vermin, haha!

'Ah, because I know human souls.
I created the silly rat king fable, and made humans scared of us more than usual. Then I send in this fella, he asks for a great price in return for his services.
The hummies inevitably try to wiggle out of paying, and thus his curse kicks in and his melody mesmerises their feeble minds and leads them to drown themselves!'

'A fair question, I suppose. Like I said, I am no mad rat. I have in fact met reasonable humans and non-humans alike. I only punish those who try to cheat their way out of a deal... well, sometimes, I also punish those who annoy me.
But, you follow those gods of yours, I am no fool to meddle with that.'

You strike Herbert down and you see Harris' eyes glisten with life. He grabs an axe and chops off Herbert's head:
'Finally! This mutated monster killed half the city of Londen, where I'm from. Been tryin' to get'im for years, then he got me instead. Thanks mate, you did us all a solid.'
He gathers himself and prepares to leave.

'I must say, I am surprised at your offer, seeing as I am what I am, I am flattered, and would stay, but I doubt we'd be a good fit in the end.
However, you have intrigued me, so perhaps you shall answer the age-old quandary for me, nature or nurture? Here, my very own pup. Will it grow up as your kin, or follow my path? I wonder...'

'Well, alright then, good luck to you'
He turns to Harris and bites into his neck, drinking his blood. The man dies in seconds. Hubert then gathers his things and departs, leaving you with the little white rat.
'I am afraid not dear, I am a Tsarat, I do not follow any human gods.'

'Oh, splendid. I did wonder, you spent so much time with human types...
Well, the play is easy, as I did before, I plant the seed of fear with a rat king infestation, Pipe Piper goes in, curse kicks in, and then we go in for the easy kills!
Two Slavyan villages will suffice. Cheerio, off I go now.'
Herbert takes his human slave, and they disappear into a rat tunnel.

Just before his departure, he hands you a small bundle:
'The brain fog is still strong in me, you take this, and you kill it, for all our sake.'
He leaves and you see within the bundle a small, white, rat pup with glowing red eyes.
You were badly beaten and forced to flee.

'Well, my ordinary vermin friend, did you like my maze? I typically have no time for failures, but I shall indulge you.
It is simple, I am a rat supreme, a Tsarat. Humans and their likes, I detest!
And so, I play with them as they do with us. Extermination. On a small scale, of course, I am not a mad rat...'

'Well, my ordinary vermin friend, I typically have no time for the likes of you, but I shall indulge you.
It is simple, I am a rat supreme, a Tsarat. Humans and their likes, I detest!
And so, I play with them as they do with us. Extermination. On a small scale, of course, I am not a mad rat...'

You kill the mutated vermin; it squeaks a little before it goes stiff.
And just as you turn away, the rat carcass changes into a small, human child, unaware of everything that just happened, alive and well, if a little ratty...

'Agreed, I see you would be a formidable enemy, I shall find easier pray elsewhere.
Come my rats, let us sail away.'
He gathers his things and leaves, but as he disappears, you see he left you a present.

'Well, my awakened friend, I was going to wait and maybe let you in on the fun, but well...
I do have another three places to visit before I move on. It is simple, I too am a rat supreme, a Tsarat. I would ask how in the rat's hell are you like me, but I shan't, my ego may not survive it...
In any case, humans and their likes, I detest! And so, I play with them as they do with us. Extermination. On a small scale, of course, I am not a mad rat...'

Adventure.name: Rat's Tale End
Adventure.nodes:
Herbert comes to join you:
'Ah, you have proven a true rat friend! I shall now grace you with my service, for I am curious where you go from now. To murder your own kind on the behest of a mere vermin, I love it!'
Herbert is dead, the Slavyans are dead. The Scavengers seem to like you a lot now...

As Herbert eats one of you, he laughs maniacally:
'Wonderful, truly wonderful, so much blood. Farewell, bloody brothers and sisters and others...'

Adventure.name: Thea Dating Game
Adventure.nodes:
Welcome to the Dating Game!
Once you enter, there will be three candidates hidden behind a screen. You will ask them a series of questions and then choose your partner!
Only one person may enter, so if you came here with a group, we will choose the lucky one randomly.
(This quest does not have the catchment area, so you can have the rest of the group stand nearby and they will not join the event when you enter with just the one character, unless you stand on the same hex.)

You already played the game, don't be greedy!
Or, even worse, you only have children in your group...

You enter an enchanted room, filled with sweet scents and pleasant things. You sit on a tall stool, and you see a heart shaped screen next to you.
Beyond this screen, you see vague silhouettes of three persons.
You can also now decide what sort of person you will try to woo.
You will ask a series of three questions, after each, you will choose whose answer you liked best, a tie breaker question will resolve any uncertainties.

'I am fearless and strong, eh... I got two, two good ones! '
'I am a, well, a muscular, I suppose, and well, confident, and lively. '

'First, I would gift you the rarest of the moon lilies so that it may adorn your perfect face. Then, we would dine under the gaze of Horz and Zarya, reflected in the perfect stillness of a beautiful lake.

'Oh, got this one. A candlelit dinner at Sam's Seaweeds Supreme!'
'Well, I would ask you what you would like to do, really and then I would make the utmost effort to make that wish come true. '
'Ah, a wise question, my fair love. In fact, I would wish for my desired form to remain unchanged by the whims of fate. '
'Nothin', I am good. '
'I suppose I would have to say, I would like to be more like you.'

Adventure.name: Nature node
Adventure.nodes:
You come to a place that emanates with foreign power. yet, in its core it seems to correspond to the divine path of Nature.
There are defenders afoot, clearly barring you from going any further.

The defenders were at first reluctant to listen, but your words rang true and so they let you pass.
One of them speaks:
'If you are sincere in your claims, you will provide Nature with a sacrifice of blood, one person will be drained to the brink of their life. If you agree, you may claim this node as yours.'
Despite your clear connection, the defenders seem unwilling to let you pass.

'It is a place of power, connected to Nature. It is... odd, actually. We heard its call and felt compelled to serve, yet it is not exactly our Nature. Still, we are mere servants, we do not question.'

The defenders are gone; you are free to approach the strange grove of evergreen trees.
You feel a blessing upon you and those of you who are akin to Nature, feel strengthened.
You also know that only those who follow Nature, may return here sometimes and perhaps gain more.

You sense this place is some kind of a conduit for the magical weaves, but only those that are intertwined with Nature.
It is certainly of a foreign origin, but you are able to dominate it easily with your domain. You sense whatever this is, it came with that odd tower.

The defenders immediately bow to your power and accept your dominance here. They leave and so you are free to approach the strange grove of evergreen trees.

The defenders push you away and as you flee, you see the strange trees disappear.

The defenders were at first reluctant to listen, but your words rang true and so they let you pass.
One of them speaks:
'If you are sincere in your claims, you will provide chaos with a sacrifice of blood, one person will be drained to the brink of their life. If you agree, you may claim this node as yours.'
Despite your clear connection, the defenders seem unwilling to let you pass.

'It is a place of power, connected to Turmoil. it is... odd, actually. We heard its call and felt compelled to serve, yet it is not exactly our Turmoil, it feels more like chaos. Still, we are mere servants, we do not question.'

The defenders are gone, you are free to approach the strange lava pit.
You feel a blessing upon you and those of you who are akin to Turmoil, feel strengthened.
You also know that only those who follow Turmoil, may return here sometimes and perhaps gain more.

You sense this place is some kind of a conduit for the magical weaves, but only those who are marked by the taint of Turmoil.
It is certainly of a foreign origin, but you are able to dominate it easily with your godly domain. You sense whatever this is, it came with that odd mirror tower.

The defenders immediately bow to your power and accept your dominance here. They leave and so you are free to approach the bustling lava formation.
You feel a blessing upon you and those of you who are akin to Turmoil, feel strengthened.
You also know that only those who follow Turmoil, may return here sometimes and perhaps gain more.
The defenders push you away and as you flee, you see the strange lava formation disappear.
The defenders are unwilling to bargain in any way.
The Chaos node beams with power and welcomes you.
The chaos node is cold, only those who follow Turmoil may enter.

Adventure.name: Fallen temple
Adventure.nodes:
You come across the ruins of an old temple, but not only is it not a temple of the Cosmic Tree gods, but it also seems corrupted by some dark force and reeks of death. You would assume Darkness, but this feels off, otherworldly perhaps?
There seems to be light coming from within the ruins, but there are defenders afoot.

You defeat the defenders and walk into the fallen temple. Within, you see an old altar, some long forgotten sculptures and religious symbols unknown to you.
Behind the altar, in what remains of the sacristy, you see a man dressed in long, tattered black robes. he is balding head is bowed, almost submerged in a large cauldron. A ginger cat lies beneath his feet. It is the cat that spots you and hisses, alerting the man to your presence. He looks up but does not react further.
The skeletons stood their ground, you cannot enter.

As you approach, you see further into the room, and realise it is larger than it should be. There are shelves filled with books and tables with alchemical tools.
There are also jars with specimens, including some odd types of blue fairies that are clearly not from Slavya and a mangy cat that is clearly playing with the body of one such fairy.
Further in the back, you see a cage and within it, a striking, blond haired woman, chained up and unconscious. You have no doubt in your mind that this is the 'Master' the gnoll spoke off, she emanates with foreign magic like a beacon.

'Oh, well, if you must know, I am Gargamus, or Gargam in short, and I am working on an alchemical concoction. Finishing touches. I mastered the technique of turning blue fairies into gold, but to make it truly stable, I caught myself this wonderful amplifier.'

'I suppose it is the most likely outcome, a side effect, really, so not my aim if that is your question?
In any case, she is a visitor here, like me. So, I'll just be finishing off here, and I'll be on my way. Both our troubles sorted, yes?'

'Not here. Her? I don't know. But I am busy.
Actually, I do need an important ingredient. So, you want to earn some goods? I will pay for you to collect some mana for me... In fact, you've already been to some magic nodes, no? Allow me to take the magic particles off you, the ones that are foreign to you anyway, so you will not feel a thing.
Then, I'll finish up here, and share some wealth with you before I go.'

'Ah that thing. A tiresome portal to some magical world, I presume. A recruitment tool, so I hear.
But useful when you want to piggyback to some worlds. It needs to find its recruit in a world, if it fails, it may or may not destroy your world...'

'Ah, yes, the troops. But I mean, do you really want a foreign wizard to take people off your world and who knows what type of damage on her way out?
Give me what I want, and I will deal with her.'
You try to attack, but this place seems to be attuned to him, and it shields the man from any physical harm.
You kill the man and his servants, and you see the woman in the cage slowly wake from her slumber.

The man hands you a few vials and asks you to inhale the contents. When you open them, there is indeed steam to inhale, and as you do, the vials become filled with liquid. The man looks pleased:
'Good, let me have a look and I'll get your payment ready.

'Hmm, it seems you failed to claim any of the nodes... still, I can do something with this... but I am afraid the reward will match the quality. Here.'
The man pours the vials he got from you into his cauldron, then opens another container, a larger one, in front of the woman. As he does so, you see her body convulse and slowly melt away into multicoloured liquid. Her eyes open in horror as she sees her body disappear...

The man then pours the new liquid into the cauldron and stirs. He then pours it out and looks like pure gold.
He looks very pleased with himself and begins to pack up to leave.

'What!?! You mean to say you can just make yourself some crystal wood, or gold, or mithril?'
He looks at you nodding and his jaw drops:
'Oh... well. Years of research, hunting, the fucking blue fairies, do you know how many times they eluded me? No, you don't, how could you. You just make yourself some gold...'

The man departs, but says to you: 'Oh, have the mangy cat, Azra, he's the one who put these ideas into my head, so he'll serve you now...' The cat looks vaguely interested and stays as commanded. Gargamus leaves the empty husk of the 'Master' on the ground and disappears in black smoke.
The rest of this fallen temple has a fading energy, and those who follow Intellect are able to syphon some of it.
'I... don't know, I may stick around, see for myself. Anyway, I shall leave to do your thing now.'

'Freya was a contender to cross over through the mirror, into what, I don't know. Some kind of magical tournament.
With her gone, one of yours can try I would imagine, but only those of near godly status should bother. Still, here, I stole one of those from Freya, it is the key to the mirror portal.'
'Well, I guess, you seem competent enough. I shall join you for now, you don't associate with blue fairies though? Never mind...'

'Freya was a contender to cross over through the mirror, into what, I don't know. Some kind of magical tournament.
With her gone, one of yours can try I would imagine, but only those of near godly status should bother. Still, here, I stole one of those from Freya, it is the key to the mirror portal.'
'No but thank you. I don't do the whole devotion to deities.'

'Freya was a contender to cross over through the mirror, into what, I don't know. Some kind of magical tournament.
With her gone, one of yours can try I would imagine, but only those of near godly status should bother. Still, here, I stole one of those from Freya, it is the key to the mirror portal.'
'Oh yes, I channelled the power of this place, a one-off thing. Just poor old me from now on I am afraid....'
'Your words are meaningless to me. I shall continue my work, for it is my life's design! Now, leave me be, or help.'

You strike her down before she is able to wake.
The rest of this fallen temple has a fading energy, and those who follow Intellect are able to syphon some of it.
You are defeated and pushed back from the temple. Soon after, the place disappears.

The defenders obey and stand aside, so you can walk into the fallen temple freely. Within, you see an old altar, some long forgotten sculptures and religious symbols unknown to you.
Behind the altar, in what remains of the sacristy, you see a man dressed in long, tattered black robes. he is balding head is bowed, almost submerged in a large cauldron. A ginger cat lies beneath his feet. It is the cat that spots you and hisses, alerting the man to your presence. He looks up but does not react further.

The woman looks at you for a time, then whispers:
'Thank you, children of the gods. I am Freya. You serv... you aided me well today. Please, open this cage and I shall join my people. Perhaps one day I will be able to repay your kindness.'
'We are passing by. My forces will leave when I go and I shall depart as soon as I gather my strength.'

'Yes, the tower is an invitation for those who are greatest in the arts of magic. And when I say greatest, I mean your gods and ancient creatures, not their children.
Within the tower, I shall pass its test and one day be called upon to a greater challenge. Fear not, your lands do not interest me beyond this.'

She looks at you for a time, then speaks:
'Yes, I am that. Still, I did not lie. I am here only to pass through the mirror tower that has chosen your land as its tetter. I seek only to answer its call, master Veles. For I know you have long abandoned such trivial pursuits, and your youngling, Marovit surely has enough to do in your absence?'
'I will face the mirror's test and prove myself the best wizard of this realm. I shall then one day be called into the tournament, and thus become a master of the magical arts.'

'I mean no offence but were it one of your gods or at least an ancient demon, I would deem it a fair challenge. Still, I will not stop you.
In fact, I shall tell you where a final place of power rests, for I sense you have encountered the others. Go, see it, try your skill. Now, free me, please.'

As the cage opens Freya takes a deep breath and chants a spell. She then disappears.
The rest of this fallen temple has a fading energy, and those who follow Intellect are able to syphon some of it.

'Ha! Please do. I will not stop you.
In fact, I shall tell you where a final place of power rests, for I sense you have encountered the others. Go, see it, try your skill. Now, free me, please.'

She looks at you for a time, then speaks:
'Some call me that, and some are right at times. I am here only to pass through the mirror tower that has chosen your land as its tetter. I seek only to answer its call, as I know your gods are far too responsible to abandon their duty and follow my path and I have not yet met a creature here that can claim my power.'

'Bah, you seem like the sort that will interfere...
Fine, I will not kill Freya, I will take some of her power, and syphon some of your life force, and leave what is left to your care, deal? I swear she will be fine... eventually. And that may be better for you anyway, what with powerful wizards roaming your lands, you just never know...'

'Oh, some reasonable folk, hmm, rare.
Actually, I do need an important ingredient. So, you want to earn some goods? I will pay for you to collect some mana for me... In fact, you've already been to some magic nodes, no? Allow me to take the magic particles off you, the ones that are foreign to you anyway, so you will not feel a thing.
Then, I'll finish up here, and share some wealth with you before I go.'

The man quickly prepares a ritual involving cooking the dried-up bodies of the blue fairies, he then gives the potion for you to drink and forces his prisoner to do so also.
Her and your life force are drained, and the man creates a portal of his own and disappears as promised.

'Good, you have claimed some of the nodes. Here, your reward.'
The man pours the vials he got from you into his cauldron, then opens another container, a larger one, in front of the woman. As he does so, you see her body convulse and slowly melt away into multicoloured liquid. Her eyes open in horror as she sees her body disappear...

Adventure.name: Chicken run
Adventure.nodes: You come across a small farm, the place looks more like a fort though, it has a palisade, a moat and various make-shift traps.

The farmers see you approach and open the gates, but you see them scanning the ground around them as you walk past.
'Come, come, but quick, we need to lock the gates.'

'Oh, well, it's the chickens, they keep trying to escape and we'll soon be ruined by those damned animals!
Go speak to Donald, he'll tell you.'

'Oh, hi. I am Donald, I own this farm. Look, I'd offer the proper Slavyan hospitality, I am not one to anger the gods. But can you please help me first?
My chickens have run amok. I think a witch cursed me... she was here, I cut her out, because you know, she was a hag... and then the chickens began to, well, I don’t know it's as if they can think now. They keep trying to escape, and at this rate, I will be ruined within the week!'
'Oh, oh, I am so sorry... It's just that she wanted to buy children from us, and well, you know, we have our boundaries!'

'Oh, thank you, thank you so much. Well, they don't react well to me. So please, go to the barn and see what is wrong with them. I mean this is a good farm, with traditions, and now all the other animals are traumatised too. No sense to those chickens...'

'Oi, you two legs. Come, come here, here.
You know how to make us fly. Right? We need to fly out of here. Did you know they make us into food!?'

These animals are clearly unnatural in their behaviour, seemingly they act more like humans would. But you notice a clear ringleader, and see the others are emulating that one chicken.
This chicken looks normal to the untrained eye, but you see it is not an animal, but some demon.
You sense there is magic at work here, but not a curse or a typical caster. One of these chickens is clearly a demon as you feel a lot of Darkness emanating from it.

'Free my chickens? What sort of suggestion is that? I run a farm! My family, my community, they are fed by me. Slavya is not a safe place, and we are not warriors like you. To have a sustainable food source is essential to us.'
The farmer and his retinue try to stop you from freeing the chickens, they don't look too dangerous, but they look determined to defend their livelihood.

You defeat the farmers and they run and hide from you, so the chickens are free to leave.
As soon as they step outside, the animals get confused and start running around like headless chickens. They scatter into the wilderness, and you hear the howling of happy wolves.One chicken remains and speaks to you:
'Well, that was fun while it lasted.'

The farmers let you and the chicken’s pass.
As soon as they leave the farm, the animals get confused and start running around like headless chickens. They scatter into the wilderness, and you hear the howling of happy wolves.
One chicken remains and speaks to you: 'Well, that was fun while it lasted.'

'Well, they're chickens, without a farmer, they just go off and die a horrible death, but free, so I think it is better.
I was only riling them up to mess with the humans. Not going to hang around a bunch of poultry. So, I am off to find other fun. Not sure if I should thank you or prank you , but bye.'

You leave the farm behind. You later hear of the fate of the farmers - unable to sustain themselves, they eventually scattered, some became bandits, some joined scavenger clans. But the chicken farm was no more.
'Listen, we know they are more than chickens, somehow, but it doesn't change things. We will not live without our farm. Please, just see if you can maybe change them back?'
The farmers chase you away and shut the farm gates tight.
'Oh, you spoil my fun. I am just messing with the humans and the chickens, it’s fun. A few more days and they'll be ready to pluck their eyes out, haha.'

You dispel the demon's magic and the chickens scatter away back to their poultry lives.
The demon cries out and runs away.

The demon gone; Donald rejoices:
'A demon then? Not the witch? Huh. You saved my farm, please come and stay for dinner, and you can have our prized chicken as payment too.'

The magic is too strong, you fail to confront it, and worse yet, the effects took you for a while too.
When you wake, you realise the farm is burnt down, the animals gone, and many of the farmers dead. You are unsure what part you played in this...

'Oh fine, spoil sport. I will move on. Bye.'
The demon leaves and the chickens scatter away back to their poultry lives.

As you talked to the demon, its magic seeped into your minds.
When you wake, you realise the farm is burnt down, the animals gone, and many of the farmers dead. You are unsure what part you played in this...

'Huh, sounds like a good idea, I'll come.'
The demon joins you and the chickens scatter away back to their poultry lives.

Donald looks at you with suspicion:
'A demon then? Not the witch? And you spared it? Eh, listen, I am grateful, but we need to repair the farm and all, so here, a reward, and bye.'
Once you manage to catch the demon, killing it proves easy and the chickens scatter away back to their poultry lives.

As you tried to catch the demon its magic seeped into your minds.
When you wake, you realise the farm is burnt down, the animals gone, and many of the farmers dead. You are unsure what part you played in this...

There is clear demon magic emanating from one of the chicken-like creatures.
The others are just poultry, but their minds are taken over by the puppeteer.

'Oh, are you a Nature wizard then? Oh no, you will dispel me now? I was having such fun... No wait, you smell different. Hmm, I came here with a wizard, but escaped. I am free now, and here you call me demon, yes? I like it. Better than a summoned unit for sure.
I am just having some fun with these humans, and chickens. A few more days and they'll be ready to pluck their eyes out, haha.'
'Hmm, I am not from around here, but my instincts tell me I am bound by this land's laws, demon laws? So sure, I will come with you for now.'

'Nah, but here, have this trinket for being a good sport. Bye.'
The demon flies away.
'Hmm, I am not from around here, but my instincts tell me I am bound by this land's laws, demon laws? So sure, I will come with you for now.'

These animals are clearly unnatural in their behaviour, seemingly they act more like humans would. But you notice a clear ringleader, and see the others are emulating that one chicken.
This chicken looks normal to the untrained eye, but you see it is not an animal, but some demon.

You see a bunch of chickens trying to construct something, others you see jumping off high ledges and trying to fly away, only to fall way before the high fence. One of them approaches:
'Oi, you two legs. Come, come here, here.
You know how to make us fly. Right? we need to fly out of here. Did you know they make us into food!?'

You see the chickens getting confused and scared. One of them finally steps out:
'Oh, their chicken brains can't take this much, you broke my toys! I am leaving...'

'Huh, sounds like a good idea, I'll come.'
The demon joins you and the chickens scatter away back to their poultry lives.

As you tried to catch the demon its magic seeped into your minds.
When you wake, you realise the farm is burnt down, the animals gone, and many of the farmers dead. You are unsure what part you played in this...

The chickens happily go into the bag, raving about how they will fly. One of them looks rather sceptical, but in the end walks into the bag too.
You throw them over the fence, and they splatter on the ground, feathers, blood and bones remain. But some chickens do survive and seem now perfectly content to return to normal farm life.

Donald runs up to you and grabs head in disbelief:
'You killed them, you just killed them all! How am I supposed to run the farm now! You stupid brutes, please, just leave us be...'

Adventure.name: Helped Freya
Adventure.nodes:
A small group of gnolls approaches you:
'You, you did good on your promise. Our master, Freya, she gifts you this pup, says if you train it well, they will be good pack member.'
They leave a small gnoll child on the ground and run off before you can even respond.

Adventure.name: Left Freya
Adventure.nodes:
A pack of angry gnolls attacks you, howling:
'You, you did not aid our master, now you die!'
You defeated the gnolls, but a pup remains alive.
The gnolls beat you badly and force you to flee.

Adventure.name: Ruined temple
Adventure.nodes:
You find the ruins of a foreign temple where Freya told you to look.
The place looks as if it has been here for centuries, yet you know it came from afar. Despite this, you sense a strong affinity to Harmony and Light.
There are however defenders afoot here, as with every other pace of power that came with the mirror tower.
You defeated the defenders and are free to explore this place of dormant power.
You are defeated and sadly, the ruins disappear.

As you first suspected, this temple must have been devoted to a deity with a domain similar to Light and Harmony, for you feel a strong affinity.
You find the altar, and upon your touch it opens a secret compartment, where an artefact has long awaited a worthy owner.
Apart from that, you feel refreshed and blessed here.
The temple is quiet and peaceful now. There is nothing of worth to be found, but you feel refreshed and blessed here.

Adventure.name: Spiritcatcher2
Adventure.nodes:
Another night falls over Thea and restless souls of the damned seek out the living in envy and anger. You can almost feel the approaching wave of these infernal wraiths seeking to burden your souls!
But this night, an odd guest is seen in the shadows: perhaps a lapiduch, but you are uncertain. It does not attack; it simply lingers nearby.
The creature fed on your spirit as you slept.
You wake troubled by many nightmares.
Thanks to the creature, your people sleep well this night, and one wakes with greater resolve!

Adventure.name: Matriona
Adventure.nodes:
You hear someone moaning and crying out in pain nearby.
As you take a few more steps forward, an armed dwarven warrior stands in your way:
'Stop. Go no further, or I swear ya be sorry! Leave'us be...'
The moans persist and you see the dwarf looks very concerned.

'Ah ya one of us, sort off... Still, ya not one of the old ones, not born under the earth. I can see it by your skin, laddie. I... I can't speak of what we have here. Just, leave'us be...'
He looks a little less convinced of his words now.

'Ah, fine, aye. I cannot in good conscience see Matriona die on me' watch, now can I?
Please, come with me and see if you can help her. She fought off one of them lightbringer fiends, so she was worn out and then, out of nowhere, some foreign witch attacked her too! Now she lies there and even her daughters can do naught...'

You see three young dwarven girls, all dressed in long, colourful skirts with red and green scarfs on their heads. They look remarkably alike, only each one of them is slightly shorter than the other.
They are kneeling next to an older woman, dressed like them, but with more grandeur. She too bares remarkable resemblance to the young ones, and she is taller and wider even than the tallest of the male warriors also gathered here.
The woman is clearly in pain, her body convulsing, and her veins swollen and red.

The woman is poisoned by something, and you suspect it is of magical nature. However, while the poison was triggered by some mystical attack, the body is still fighting a physical malady. You may not be able to cure this entirely, but you could try to make her well enough so she can seek mystical aid.
The three young women allow you to aid their mother, as they call her.

Your potion worked and within hours, the woman's breathing improves, and she looks more at peace.
The three younger women speak to you in unison:
'Matriona is our most sacred earth mother and you have saved her life. She will return underground, and there she will be rid of the foul taint. One of us will remain with you in thanks.'

'We can't tell ya all, we are sworn, like our surface brethren, not to tell. But ya aided us and ya are the child of Mokosh too.
We are rare, we are powerful. We were called upon to shape the earth from below. We hold our kin together. We do not leave our post. We raise our young ones, we keep'em safe.'

'We are few, we do not leave, even when the dark came, even when the earth was angry at us and sent most of'us out. We stayed.
But there are a few more of'us now. The Yaga, she is a sister to'us and she woke our spirit and called'us to come out. So, some of us are out now. For a bit. Tis' a real treat, and happens only every millennium, you know. There I said all. Now, let us leave.'

Whatever magic accursed the dwarven woman, it hit back and hurt your spirit. The three younger women speak to you in unison:
'You tried, we thank'ya. Now, please go. we must focus, before Matriona dies, we must make her spirit one with the earth...'

'We can't tell ya all, we are sworn, like our surface brethren, not to tell. But ya aided us and ya are the child of Mokosh too.
We are rare, we are powerful. We were called upon to shape the earth from below. We hold our kin together. We do not leave our post. we raise our young ones, we keep'em safe.'

'We are few, we do not leave, even when the dark came, even when the earth was angry at us and sat most of'us out. We stayed.
But there are a few more of'us now. The Yaga, she is a sister to'us and she woke our spirit and called'us to come out. So, some of us are out now. For a bit. Tis' a real treat, and happens only every millennia, you know. There I said all. Now, please leave.'

Your magic worked and within hours, the woman's breathing improves and she looks more at peace.
The three younger women speak to you in unison:
'Matriona is our most sacred earth mother and you have saved her life. She will return underground to recover fully. One of us will remain with you in thanks.'

The dwarven warrior looks to the young girls for permission and then speaks after they nod:
'Matriona, that is her name. She is our... she is special to'us dwarves. We were escorting her from a fallen fortress to another. But we were cut off from our forces and forced to find another route. Her life force attracts all sorts of creatures, so we were attacked.

'Well, we need a witch, or a healer. If ya have none... It is a lot to ask, but the matrioshkas, they are doing a ritual. Only we are too worn out now. If you lend us your strength. It may hurt or worse, but it may save her and we will pay!'

The ritual worked and within hours, the woman's breathing improves, and she looks more at peace.
The three younger women speak to you in unison:
'Matriona is our most sacred earth mother and you have saved her life. She will return underground to recover fully. One of us will remain with you in thanks.'

The woman is poisoned by something and you suspect it is of foreign magical nature. You sense an odd fluctuation of Nature that feels somehow off. But, because it is not of this realm, you know you can try to untangle its grip on the dwarf.
The three young women allow you to aid their mother, as they call her.
'No, this is a matter for dwarven royalty only, ya're not it. Leave'us.'

'Ah ya proved to be a dwarven friend... Still, ya not one of the old ones, not born under the earth... I can't speak of what we have here. Just, leave'us be...'
He looks a little less convinced of his words now.

'Bah, ya ain't one of us, you ain't an Earthbound friend. I can't speak of what we have here. Just, leave'us be...'
He looks a little less convinced of his words now.

You killed the dwarven guards and you now see a small group of women hunched over someone. One of them raises her hands, pleading:
'Take what ya won, but please, leave'us be. Matriona will die, but she deserves to die in peace, with us.'

'Were we not worn out from shielding our Matriona I'd give ya lasses an ass woopin', but ya ain't killin' us and she's more to me than me pride. If only our men could understand it...
Please, see if you can help'us. She fought off one of them lightbringer fiends, so she was worn out and then, out of nowhere, some foreign witch attacked her too! Now she lies there and even her daughters can do naught...'

You now see that there are three young dwarven girls, all dressed in long, colourful skirts with red and green scarfs on their heads. They look remarkably alike, only each one of them is slightly shorter than the other.
They are kneeling next to an older woman, dressed like them, but with more grandeur. She too bares remarkable resemblance to the young ones, and she is taller and wider even than the tallest of the male warriors you killed.
The woman is clearly in pain, her body convulsing, and her veins swollen and red.

'Well, we need a witch, or a healer. If ya have none... It is a lot to ask, but we are the matrioshkas, we know the magic arts you see, and we are doing a ritual. only we are too worn out now. If you lend us your strength. It may hurt or worse, but it may save her, and we will pay!'

'We can't tell ya all, we are sworn, like our surface brethren, not to tell. But even if ya did kill our men, ya aided us and her life is worth more than any earth warrior.
We are rare, the matrioshka, we are powerful. We were called upon to shape the earth from below. We hold our kin together. We do not leave our post. we raise our young ones, we keep'em safe.'

The dwarven warrior looks to the young girls for permission and then speaks after they nod:
'Ah. You're with the human lot, so you may not remember the old tales, but this is the Matriona, the sacred mother of the matrioshka lassies who can do magic. We were escorting her from a fallen fortress to another. But we were cut off from our forces and forced to find another route. Her life force attracts all sorts of creatures, so we were attacked.'
You barely escape the angry dwarves.

Adventure.name: Flowers
Adventure.nodes: Among a small grouping of trees, you discover a patch of wildflowers, blooming in many wondrous colours and sweet scents.

As a creature of the woodland, you know the flowers are a manifestation of good forest spirits and will give you blessings if you inhale enough of their scent.
But you could also try a more challenging path and the spirits of the forest to grant you a gift.

You come closer and feel the sweet scent surrounding you. For those akin to Nature, it is pleasant, but for others it may bring harm.
When you try to step forwards, you feel an almost physical resistance testing your spiritual resolve.
Your spirit proved strong and you feel the warm glow embrace you kindly. Whatever test this may have been, you clearly passed.

Adventure.name: Traveling Pet Trader
Adventure.nodes: 'Howdy there, travellers. May I interest you in my wares? I sell exotic pets from the lands of great magic mastery'

Adventure.name: RatChildGrowingupSEA
Adventure.nodes: The white rat pup is growing up. Through its parentage, it will progress on its own, but you can direct them as you see fit.
The rat pup was able to grow into a fierce warrat.
The rat pup was able to grow into a talented mystrat.
The rat pup was able to grow into a great healrat.

Adventure.name: RatChildGrowingup2SEA
Adventure.nodes:
Your white rat has grown in power, and it can now become a tsarat!
Beware, they will face a deadly challenge to prove they are worthy.
